SAA.title: Alchemy Workshop
SAA.bookDescription: A physical book containing one C{complexity} formula. Use the Alchemy Workshop to study or craft. Its cover matches the complexity.
SAA.workbenchSubtitle: Consult a book or use a memorized recipe.
SAA.emptyHint: The GM can install a kit, give its book and ingredients to your character, and reopen this workshop.
SAA.noBooks: This character has no alchemy books identified by the module.
SAA.noMemory: This character has not memorized a recipe yet.
SAA.studyNotice: First study requires one hour with the source in hand. This records game time agreed with the GM.
SAA.studyTimeAcknowledged: The hour of study has elapsed or was approved by the GM.
SAA.studyRecorded: Study recorded. Select the recipe to craft.
SAA.safePace: Play Safe — one time band, advantage
SAA.heroicEnhancement: Recipe enhancement, subject to GM review
SAA.bonusNotice: Intelligence, tool proficiency and check bonuses on the sheet are included. Use this field for another approved bonus, such as Guidance 1d4.
SAA.consumptionNotice: Resolving the check consumes the ingredients, including on failure. The book remains.
SAA.timeAcknowledged: The crafting time has elapsed or was approved by the GM.
SAA.flawedProduct: Flawed product — the GM must define its limitation before use.
SAA.heroicProduct: Heroic enhancement — review with the GM.
SAA.heroicManual: The GM determines an appropriate enhancement before use.
SAA.distinctFormulas: distinct formulas toward the next level
SAA.advancementNotice: This counts distinct formulas. The GM confirms study, proficiency and narrative requirements, and sets the alchemical level in the manager.
SAA.managerSubtitle: Prepare the world and add kits to your collection.
SAA.kitRegistered: Kit loaded. Use Install kit to add its content to the world.
SAA.updateModels: Also update existing templates (replaces edits to these templates).
SAA.installNotice: Installation creates world templates. The GM gives copies of books and ingredients to characters. Importing does not alter existing character sheets.
SAA.permanentInt: Permanent INT modifier for memorization (empty: automatic)
SAA.toolOverrideNotice: The sheet supplies access and proficiency. Enable a manual override only for a borrowed laboratory, old import or another GM ruling. 0 = untrained; 0.5 = half; 1 = proficient; 2 = expertise.
SAA.recoveryNotice: An interrupted craft is pending. Compare sheet items with this record, manually correct what is needed, then confirm reconciliation. This button only unlocks new requests; it does not alter quantities.
SAA.reconciled: I checked and reconciled this character’s ingredients and products.
SAA.help1: The GM enables the module and opens Alchemy — Manage. Folders and shortcuts are prepared automatically.
SAA.help2: Install the free demo or load a JSON kit. Each recipe becomes a Journal note and a physical book.
SAA.help3: Drag the book and ingredients from the Item folders to the sheet. Include a suitable tool or record physical access in the manager.
SAA.help4: The player selects their token and runs Alchemy — Craft Item. Record first study and choose a recipe. A GM must be connected.
SAA.help5: Review materials, pace and game time. Resolve the check. Successes track progress and can memorize the formula; memory stays on the sheet without the book.
SAA.scopeNotice: The engine automates core crafting rules. Damage, conditions, flawed product limitations, enhancements and narrative effects require GM rulings. Specializations, batches and other optional subsystems remain table-managed in this version. Foraging and commercial packs are separate products.
SAA.contentLanguageHint: Language used when importing kits; existing templates change only when updating them.
SAA.safeC5: Play Safe is unavailable for this complexity or time band.
SAA.heroicSafe: Heroic Challenge cannot be combined with Play Safe.
SAA.invalidRoll: The check did not return a valid d20.
SAA.notOwner: You must own this character sheet.
SAA.unexpected: The operation did not complete. Check the console for details.
SAA.kitRead: Could not load the kit from {name}.
SAA.kitMissing: No kit available. Enable a pack or load its JSON.
SAA.dependenciesMissing: Install the ingredients and products required by this kit first.
SAA.noRecipe: This recipe requires a book on the sheet or recorded memorization.
SAA.bookMissing: First study requires the book in inventory.
SAA.timeRequired: Confirm the game time before continuing.
SAA.pendingRecovery: This sheet has an interrupted craft. The GM must reconcile it in the manager.
SAA.notStudied: Study the source for one hour before crafting.
SAA.levelRequired: This character’s alchemical level does not allow this complexity.
SAA.toolMissing: Physical access to a compatible tool is required.
SAA.proficiencyRequired: This complexity requires compatible proficiency or approved supervision for C3.
SAA.ingredientsMissing: Ingredients are missing for this craft.
SAA.invalidActor: Could not read Intelligence and proficiency from this sheet.
SAA.productMissing: The product template is missing. Reimport the kit.
SAA.inventoryChanged: Inventory changed during the operation. Review the sheet and try again.
SAA.gmRequired: A GM must be connected to validate and process alchemy requests.
SAA.requestTimeout: The GM has not responded yet. The request may be pending: check the result and inventory before sending another.
SAA.selectOne: Select only one token to craft.
SAA.noActor: Select a token or assign a character to the player.
SAA.systemRequired: Sant Ana Alchemy requires the dnd5e system.
